name: Free answer
description: Answer in your own words, with markdown and math that render as you type, or in a code editor. A decision model grades it against a reference and rubric, and a language model writes feedback.

fields.name: input
fields.description: long (markdown with live math, the default) | text (one line) | code (code editor) | plain (bare textarea)

fields.name: language
fields.description: For input: code. Any language name or extension (python, c, rust, sql, ...).

instructions: Judge whether the answer shows the understanding the reference and rubric describe. Wording, order and length do not matter; missing or wrong concepts do. A correct idea stated in different words is correct. An answer that contains the right idea next to a clear factual error is partially correct.
